mods.name: conventional-commits
mods.description: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, imperative, under 72 characters.

mods.name: tdd-mode
mods.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

mods.name: ste-mode
mods.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

mods.name: security-mode
mods.description: Checks each change for injection, secrets, authorization and unsafe input, and states the risks it checked.

mods.name: yoda-mode
mods.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

mods.name: team-pack
mods.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.
